Audit.name: tools/app_crawler.py
Audit.description: Crawls through the application's GUI and systems to find problems including HTML issues, JavaScript problems, API endpoint validation, broken links, unformatted dates, missing dependencies, and Python code issues.
Audit.effects: Writes reports to tools/crawl_report.json, tools/crawler_issues.json, tools/crawler_report.html. No database modifications.

Audit.name: tools/gui_crawler.py
Audit.description: Crawls GUI for errors, broken links, and issues. Checks HTML files for [object Object] patterns, undefined functions, missing image sources, and fetch calls to relative URLs.
Audit.effects: Generates crawl report with issues list. No file modifications.

Audit.name: tools/generate_admin_audit_pdf.py
Audit.description: Introspects the running FastAPI application to enumerate all admin-protected routes and generates a comprehensive PDF report.
Audit.effects: Writes PDF to docs/reports/Semptify_Admin_Audit.pdf. No database modifications.

Audit.name: scripts/smoke_admin_routes.py
Audit.description: Smoke tests all admin console GET endpoints to check for 500 errors without admin auth.
Audit.effects: No file modifications. Only HTTP requests.

Audit.name: scripts/test_all_links.py
Audit.description: Comprehensive HTML link validator that tests every link from every HTML page end-to-end. Extracts href, src, action, onclick, and data-* links.
Audit.effects: Generates broken_links_report.json and link_test_results.json. No file modifications.

Inventory.name: tools/generate_module_routes_list.py
Inventory.description: Regenerates module_routes_list.txt from app/modules/*/router.py files by counting HTTP route decorators.

Inventory.name: scripts/generate_compliance_inventory.py
Inventory.description: Generates a CSV inventory of module/router/service compliance entries using app.core.compliance discovery.

Inventory.name: scripts/list_admin_routes.py
Inventory.description: Lists all admin console routes for verification.
Inventory.effects: No file modifications. Only prints to console.

Cleanup.name: tools/archive_resolved_duplicates.py
Cleanup.description: Archives resolved/rejected duplicate-resolve tasks out of the workbook by removing matching rows from 'Duplicates' sheet and appending to 'Archive' sheet.
Cleanup.effects: Modifies Semptify_Master_Inventory_LIVE_reviewed.xlsx and agent_orchestrator_tasks.json. Requires Excel to be closed.

Cleanup.name: scripts/cleanup_duplicates.py
Cleanup.description: Removes duplicate documents from the index, keeping the earliest upload for each unique file_hash per user. Also cleans up orphaned files.
Cleanup.effects: Modifies data/documents/index.json and deletes duplicate files from disk.

Cleanup.name: scripts/clean_workspace.ps1
Cleanup.description: Cleans workspace by removing the SemptifyBundle.zip file.

Update/Migration.name: scripts/apply_timeline_migration.py
Update/Migration.description: Applies timeline migration manually to handle SQLite schema. Creates unified_timeline view and marks migration as applied.
Update/Migration.effects: Modifies database schema (creates view, updates alembic_version table).

Update/Migration.name: scripts/drop_certification_tables.py
Update/Migration.description: Drops document_registry and certification_events tables as part of stateless mandate migration.
Update/Migration.effects: Drops database tables. Safe to re-run.

Update/Migration.name: scripts/drop_extracted_data_column.py
Update/Migration.description: Drops extracted_data_json column from vault_index table as part of stateless mandate migration.
Update/Migration.effects: Alters database schema. Safe to re-run.

Update/Migration.name: scripts/fix_datetime_consistency.py
Update/Migration.description: Replaces all instances of datetime.now(timezone.utc) with utc_now() to ensure consistent timezone handling throughout Semptify.
Update/Migration.effects: Modifies Python files in app/ directory. Adds import statements.

Update/Migration.name: scripts/migrate_complaints.py
Update/Migration.description: Migration script that adds new columns to complaints table for the Complaint Wizard.
Update/Migration.effects: Alters database schema (adds columns). Safe to re-run.

Update/Migration.name: scripts/sync_db.py
Update/Migration.description: Database sync between local SQLite and Neon PostgreSQL. Supports export and import operations.
Update/Migration.effects: Reads/writes database data. Exports to db_export.json.

Orchestration.name: tools/_seed_orchestrator_tasks.py
Orchestration.description: Seeds tools/agent_orchestrator_tasks.json with a fresh consolidated todo list from BUILD_STATE.md, ACTIVE_CONTEXT.md, FNG_TODO.md, and STUB_AUDIT.md.
Orchestration.effects: Writes docs_todos.json. Overwrites agent_orchestrator_tasks.json when merged.

Orchestration.name: tools/sync_orchestrator.py
Orchestration.description: One command that keeps stub detection, master workbook, and agent orchestrator UI in sync. Runs stub_detector, workbook_bridge, embeds tasks JSON into HTML.
Orchestration.effects: Writes stub_tasks_new.json, agent_orchestrator_tasks.json, agent_orchestrator.html, orchestrator_dashboard.html. May re-stage files for git.

Orchestration.name: tools/workbook_bridge.py
Orchestration.description: Bridges from Semptify_Master_Inventory_LIVE_reviewed.xlsx to agent_orchestrator.json using live stub list from stub_detector.py.

Orchestration.name: tools/mark_task_status.py
Orchestration.description: Marks a single task's status in agent_orchestrator_tasks.json for AI agents to call when picking up or finishing tasks.
Orchestration.effects: Modifies agent_orchestrator_tasks.json. Uses file-based lock for concurrent safety.

Orchestration.name: tools/workorder_runner.py
Orchestration.description: Claims, completes, and rejects tasks from agent_orchestrator_tasks.json safely for concurrent agents using file locks.

Orchestration.name: tools/dispatch_batch.py
Orchestration.description: Dispatches first 3 HIGH priority tasks from agent_orchestrator_tasks.json to a markdown file.

Setup/Install.name: scripts/Reset-Local-Postgres.ps1
Setup/Install.description: Resets local PostgreSQL configuration by temporarily allowing trusted localhost auth, resetting postgres password, creating/updating semptify role and database.
Setup/Install.effects: Modifies pg_hba.conf, restarts PostgreSQL service, creates database and user. Requires Administrator.

Setup/Install.name: scripts/Setup-PostgreSQL-Extensions.ps1
Setup/Install.description: Sets up PostgreSQL extensions (uuid-ossp, pg_trgm, pgcrypto, btree_gin, btree_gist) for Semptify.
Setup/Install.effects: Creates database, user, and installs extensions. No data modifications.

Setup/Install.name: scripts/init_postgres.py
Setup/Install.description: Initializes PostgreSQL database with all tables by running Base.metadata.create_all.
Setup/Install.effects: Creates all tables in database. No data modifications.

Setup/Install.name: scripts/SemptifyLauncher.ps1
Setup/Install.description: One-click startup with browser selection. Smart routing: Setup Wizard (first run) or Command Center (configured). Shows GUI for browser/profile selection.
Setup/Install.effects: Starts uvicorn server as background process, launches browser. No file modifications.

Utility.name: scripts/backup.py
